w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 🗣️ Valentina to Vasyl, by the fire: "225 wood. We need 350. The forest isn't going to cut itself."
Riders on the ridge — no, a cart. A TRADER. Word travels: Haven has food, and where there's food there's trade.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (17/8/7), with 4 wave-4 fought, 5 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 2 · Forage 3 · Craft 2 · Talk 13 · Explore 29 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Jesse Cortez ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

firenarr.line: ⚠ The store has fallen far from its recent high again — the shelves are nearly bare.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,260 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.
